claims.natural_statement: For a finite pool of n distinct primes, positive integer B0, nonnegative divisor cap D, nonincreasing integer records 0<=R<B0, and adaptive integers equal on stable deletion edges, uniform consecutive-size sampling with ell,T>0 and ell+T-1<=n satisfies E[full bad fraction] <= (F(ell-1)-F(ell+T-1))/T + (D/T) sum_t 1/(n-t+1) <= (B0-1)/T + D/(n-ell-T+2). The generic Lean incidence and coarse numerical lemmas do not themselves encode the concrete probability composition.

For the manuscript actual full rational evaluation kernels, comparison of B with B union {q}, with S, anchor, other blocks and degree allowances fixed, gives lexicographic nonincrease of evaluation ranks; equal complete mixed-radix records imply identical normalized paths and minors in that comparable comparison, not for arbitrary incomparable blocks.

Under the actual Section 3 fixed weighted-box and total-geometric-component degree convention, fixed ordinary cut degrees and fixed path length give coefficient-independent bounded patch degrees, bounded-height integer equations and nonzero evaluated minor products |m|<=X^K, hence at most floor(K/zeta) distinct divisors at least X^zeta.

Conditional on the separate residue-cut input supplying common fixed stage degrees, the ordered gamma, degrees, B0,K, xi,T,zeta,ell_i, then X schedule and uniform finite bound yield one block choice making at least half the points regular and cumulative good-prime product at least X^(delta_(h_i)+gamma/2) at every stage; no full affine or density conclusion is asserted.

For any fixed positive degree allowances, the existing union-of-rational-lines construction admits permitted deterministic full-kernel patches with full singleton bad probability 1, deleted bad probability 0, and a strictly changed rank record. It refutes only a proposed full-minor independence proof, not the manuscript.

The inventoried adaptive draft and local formal certificates do not establish C9000020 or the seven broader density, tail, sieve, remaining-input, affine-counting, residue-cut and counting-tree obligations; these remain unresolved by that draft rather than refuted.

claims.natural_statement: In general, conditional on the deleted subset and other blocks, the removed prime can be treated as independent of its own full-path minor for a fixed-integer divisor-budget estimate. This is the historical alternative assertion under review, not an accepted premise.

routes.retired_because: Imported historical failed alternative, not retried: the legitimate singleton line patch has full minor equal to the selected prime p (product p^2 if repeated), while deleted plane minors are 1. Conditional uniformity fixes only the deleted-path integer, so a fixed-integer divisor budget cannot be applied to the full minor. The rank record changes and the correct deletion theorem survives.
